description: We are Team ASENA from Bursa! We join the "Dancing with the SARs" challenge. Our mission: visualize Earth's dance using NISAR SAR data. We will build a web map showing surface changes (earthquakes, floods, deforestation) with animation. Skills: Python, data viz, Folium/Leaflet, storytelling, UI/UX. Looking for Earth observation fans, frontend devs & storytellers. Beginners welcome!
summary:
Our project is an AI-powered disaster monitoring and awareness platform designed to help people access reliable information about natural disasters. We developed an interactive world map that displays events such as earthquakes and wildfires, allowing users to monitor disasters in different regions.

The platform also aims to use artificial intelligence to analyze disaster-related images uploaded by users, helping identify potentially misleading content and recognize real disaster situations.

By combining real-time data, interactive maps, and AI technology, our project addresses the challenges of information gaps, misinformation, and limited access to disaster-related information.

We believe this project is important because access to accurate information can make a difference during emergencies. Our goal is to help communities become more aware, informed, and prepared for natural disasters.
details:
Our project is an AI-powered platform aimed at tracking natural disasters and providing people with easier access to information during emergencies.

On our website, disasters such as earthquakes and wildfires can be viewed through an interactive world map. Users can monitor disasters across different regions and have the disaster photos they upload analyzed by artificial intelligence. In this way, we aim to reduce the spread of misinformation and ensure that real disaster situations are recognized more quickly.

While developing our project, we utilized technologies such as React, JavaScript, Python, FastAPI, Supabase, and Leaflet. Additionally, we used GitHub, Vercel, and Render.

The most innovative aspect of our project is bringing disaster data, a mapping system, and artificial intelligence together on a single platform. Throughout the development process, we prioritized accuracy, reliability, ease of use, and social benefit.

Our goal is not only to display disasters, but also to contribute to raising public awareness about them and helping people become better prepared against potential hazards.
